name: electronics-ai-assistant
description: Assistente de IA local para consertos de eletrônica

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5176 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VOLT_FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:5176 VOLT_BACKEND_PORT=3003 electron . --disable-gpu --disable-gpu-compositing --in-process-gpu --no-sandbox --disable-features=RendererCodeIntegrity
scripts.kill: taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T & taskkill /F /IM electron.exe /T & echo Processos encerrados
